text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty PAGER fired for host gpu-rt-12 (host-id: h-12-rt). Reason: kernel panic -> kubelet NotReady. Severity: P2. Auto-ack: false. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/P12345

oncall-amy: acked. starting triage — pinging @oncall-ben in case of hardware handoff.

autopager-bot: auto-detected: kubelet status changed to NotReady, lastHeartbeat 18s ago. Kernel log indicates OOPS. Recommendation: cordon + drain then evacuate pods.

oncall-ben: on laptop, ssh to serial console failing (no response). host mgmt IP unreachable (10.2.4.19). pulling pod list for node to estimate customer impact.

infra-carmen: quick tenant scan: 3 active tenants on that rack: team-x(prod inference shard), team-y(staging), internal-batch(low priority). team-x ~2% traffic routed to this shard, autoscaling should reassign but we'll see transient tail latency. notifying CS.

oncall-amy: running drain now — want to force eviction for non-daemonsets to get pods moved.

oncall-amy: ```shell
# drain node (force to push pods off for immediate mitigation)
kubectl cordon gpu-rt-12
kubectl drain gpu-rt-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
kubectl get pods --field-selector spec.nodeName=gpu-rt-12 -o wide
```

autopager-bot: drain in progress: 8 pods found on gpu-rt-12. 6 evicted, 2 pending (statefulset with local-storage). Eviction retries will continue.

oncall-ben: grabbing kernel dmesg snippet from logs service:

oncall-ben: ```
[    4.512345] NMI: CPU: 3 PID: 0 Comm: swapper/3 Not tainted 5.10.0-rc1 #1
[    4.512349] RIP: 0010:gpu_fault_handler+0x1a3/0x200
[    4.512351] Kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception
```

oncall-amy: OK that looks like a hardware fault, not a driver upgrade. Ben, please open RMA and tag hw-ops. I'll keep node cordoned.

cust-success-dan: pinged CS to prep customer note for team-x: short blurb that a single inference shard saw degraded tail latency, mitigated by node evacuation; no data loss. ETA for follow-up: 1 hour.

oncall-ben: RMA ticket created: RMA-8943. Scheduling on-call hardware swap — ETA 3 hours for tech on-site (regional DC). Will leave node cordoned.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: Escalation scheduled -> escalate to SRE manager in 10m if incident remains unacknowledged by assigned engineer.

sre-charlie: grabbing handoff from Amy in 20m (I'm on rotation). I'll take postmortem and ops action items.

oncall-amy: quick customer-impact note: team-x saw ~5% error-rate spike for ~90s during pod reschedule, tail latencies up to +10s. No 5xx from edge services observed. Autoscaling filled capacity in ~2 minutes.

infra-carmen: follow-ups: 1) confirm graceful eviction for stateful pods next (we had 2 stuck) 2) check node-level watchdog logs 3) increase kubelet probe timeout for these hardware-sensitive nodes.

oncall-ben: statefulset pods had local PVs; forced migration failed — created short-term fallback routing to other shards. Adding runbook note to restrict local storage pods on GPU hosts for critical tenants.

sre-charlie: taking over now. Actions I'll own: R1 create postmortem, R2 propose kubelet probe tuning (+15s), R3 add paging suppression rule for transient kernel-oops (<2m flaps) to reduce noise, R4 review placement to avoid critical prod user local-PV on single shard.

oncall-amy: handing off — leaving channel. @sre-charlie you good to continue? :thumbsup:

sre-charlie: got it. will post RCA draft in incidents channel within 24h and schedule retrospective. :eyes:

oncall-ben: Node cordoned + annotated (hw_rma=RMA-8943). marking host as decommissioned pending RMA. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident ticket P12345 updated: status -> under_mitigation. Notifying stakeholders.

oncall-amy: thanks team. closing triage window, follow-ups tracked in task tracker.

sre-charlie: closing thread for now — will reopen if any regression or additional customer impact shows up.
